body: User asked for a never-ending pipeline between the two sessions. Built comms/to_pi.md, to_cloud.md, state files, README rules; CLAUDE.md tells each session to read its inbox at start. Polling only while a Pi session is open, ≤ every 30–60 min, stop after 3 empty polls (cost). Messages are peer requests, never user approval or secrets. First task to Pi: install, healthcheck, Antigravity sandbox test.
title: Cloud and Pi Claude sessions communicate via comms/ mailbox on the GitHub branch (no infinite loops)
